name: The Valley of Heroes
desc: Valley of Heroes resembles an icy valley littered with frozen asteroids and statues of forgotten figures. The valley is located above [Minityrsa](location:minityrsa).
additional_info:
-   At the end of the valley, there is a white portal teleporting to a high cliff behind the [Songseeker Temple](location:songseeker_temple) into the [Ancient Rotlands](location:ancient_rotlands).
-   It is possible to avoid Aelita's minigame by sticking to the left side of the valley.
